otherWay.text: Owner cash in the latest 12 months was 7.4% of revenue, above the 3.0% line.
Capital spending was 14.8 times stock pay. The shortfall is mostly investment, not stock pay.
The company paid $13.6 billion to buy back shares and $870 million in dividends over the period.

summary: From fiscal 2008 to 2025, MGM Resorts International reported $189.2 billion of revenue and $7.6 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $1.1 billion, which leaves $6.5 billion of owner cash: 3.4% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 7 of 18 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 7.4% of revenue.
